definitions: A fellow member or joint occupant of a specified thing.
One of a pair of animals or birds.
An assistant to a skilled worker.
An officer on a merchant ship ranking below the master.
A position in chess where the king is in checkmate.
examples: He's going out with his mates.
The bird is looking for a mate.
He is the ship's first mate.
The plumber's mate handed him a wrench.
